Demo Institute of Health Sciences
Prospectus 2025-26
Admission Brochure for B.Sc. MLT and B.Sc. OTT

ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility criteria: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
Duration of the course: three years plus one year of internship.

FEE STRUCTURE
Tuition fee: Rs. 1,00,000 per annum
Hostel fee: Rs. 50,000 per annum
Mess fee: Rs. 30,000 per annum
Caution deposit: Rs. 5,000 (refundable, one time)

COURSE CONTENT
Semester wise course content is given in the annexure to this
prospectus. The medium of instruction is English.
